title: rule-1-encapsulation
intention: RULE 1 — ENCAPSULATION: every component (device, machine, tool, skill, anything with a boundary) talks to every other component only through that component's DECLARED public interface; a device's public interface is the bus plus any client tool it publishes; internals are private, and one check reds any reach past a public interface the moment it is written.
why: Akien, 2026-10-01 (answer to open-6c699d2b81ef, verbatim): "NO DEVICE MAY IMPORT ANOTHERS DEVICE PERIOD. ONLY OVER THE BUS. Why is this so hard? no don't answer, just fuckin fix it. DAMN IT!" — widened minutes later: "RULE 1 is this: ENCAPSULATION. ... WHY? BECUASE THAT REDUCES IMPACTS OF CHANGES ACROSS BOUNDARIES. THIS APPLIES TO MORE THAN DEVICES, MACHINES AND TOOLS." — and corrected to the agreed form: "DEVICES, MACHINES, TOOLS, each >>COMPONENT<< may only talk to other components via their public interfaces. and the public interface for devices is the bus." The lived symptom: a change in one component breaks another it never declared it would touch, and the system has outgrown any single mind's ability to hold every such reach in its head (memory encapsulation-is-the-complexity-budget). Direction signal, noted and NOT acted on: "a long time ago i asked you if this should be seperate repos. one for each device. you said no. that was a mistake."
traces_to: Law 6 (one owner gates writes; delegated access only through the owner's gate — a reach past an interface is ambient access), Law 4 (a rule that matters is physics — the sieve), Law 1 (a change confined to its component is not re-derived everywhere it leaked), and the Telos via CP4: the system exceeds a single mind's complexity limit and encapsulation is what keeps each piece inside it (memory encapsulation-is-the-complexity-budget). Akien, 2026-10-01: 'it limits a change to the component that made it. Contracts let A change without breaking B.'
how: Three moves. (1) The rule becomes an intention at the top of the corpus: a spanning intention CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code/I-rule-1-encapsulation.md carrying Akien's agreed text verbatim, and CLAUDE.md gains a RULE 1 block ABOVE the Laws that points to it — the Laws keep their numbers (a Law's number is its address). (2) Physics: every charter declares `public_interface` (the dotted modules others may import; a device declares none — the bus is its interface — and a nested client tool it publishes declares `published_by_device`); one sieve in build_inspector reds every cross-component import that does not land in the target's declared interface, superseding device_isolation_holds and machine_imports_no_device and absorbing ticket 7b5c539cb58c. (3) Clear the census, cast as children: measured 2026-10-01 by AST over cairn/, skills/, bin/, launchers/ — 380 code sites and 809 proof/probe sites cross a component boundary; of those, 51 code + 252 instrument sites reach INTO another device (top clusters: tester/scratch.py 77 proof imports, db_domain store 48, ground_loop discovery 20, codemother machines from skills/chart 15, tester validation_store 16). Each edge clears by a bus verb (the caller wants a device to act), a code move down a rung (a primitive the device happens to hold), or a published client tool (db_domain, for graph-tree volume the bus can't carry). Hollow's subject set follows: a ticket's build is its files inside its own component (answer to open-fc534f53014d).
falsifier: Parent falsifier: GREEN when (1) CLAUDE.md carries a RULE 1 block above the Laws that points at CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code/I-rule-1-encapsulation.md, whose body is Akien's agreed 2026-10-01 text verbatim, with the Law numbers unchanged (diff of the '## The Laws' block shows no renumbering); (2) every child is PROVED; (3) the live build_inspector run shows zero findings from the encapsulation sieve across cairn/, skills/, bin/ and launchers/, proofs and probes included. RED if any of the three fails at the horizon. WRONG INTENT if a proof cannot be written inside its component without another device's internals and neither a bus verb nor a published client tool can carry it — escalated as one question with the measurement. Horizon: the first live inspector pass after the last child is PROVED.
